title: #72 child: governed generic execution adapter for agent-skills capabilities
disposition: PROGRESS, NOT CLOSURE. One of three representative classes proven fully live end-to-end; the other two hit verified obstacles documented below. Not closing to avoid a premature-close reopen.

environment.providers_verified: code-runner via scillm/codex(gpt-5.5) live; review-code check openai=ok anthropic=ok; github/claude-sonnet-4.5 live

required_proof_map.bullet: exact hash binding for SKILL.md, entrypoint, input, goal, policy, boundary
required_proof_map.evidence: bind_contract() sha256 hash-drift fail-closed; existing tests

required_proof_map.bullet: one live local read-only skill execution whose native artifact is validated and admitted
required_proof_map.evidence: review-code ran LIVE via github/claude-sonnet-4.5 (50.9s real provider call, response 1616 chars). BLOCKER: review-code emits {meta, response:<free text>}, not structured review_code.result.v1; admitting it requires a lossy prose->findings normalizer. Not admitted end-to-end.

required_proof_map.bullet: one live bounded mutation whose diff is admitted and whose unapproved paths are rejected
required_proof_map.evidence: code-runner ran LIVE via scillm/codex in an isolated worktree (source_unchanged=true, dod_passed=true, best_score=1.0). governed_skill_execution.normalize_code_runner_native_result compiled the native output into code_runner.result.v1 (verdict DERIVED from dod_passed+allowlist, not native status); tau code-runner-skill-adapter ADMITTED it: status PASS, code_patch_receipt_status PASS, errors []. NEGATIVE: patch restricted to docs/** -> BLOCKED 'patch target_file is outside allowed_paths'. See bounded-mutation/.

required_proof_map.bullet: one external/effectful execution with #218 ownership, success evidence, and duplicate suppression/reconciliation
required_proof_map.evidence: create-evidence-case ran LIVE via scillm and persisted an external effect (storage upsert _key=3d17a4deecab0d3a). Duplicate suppression PROVEN: two live runs of the same claim produced the identical stored _key (idempotent identity = sha256(control_ids+verdict)[:16]). BLOCKER (verified): read-back via the skill's own `get` returns 'not found in /memory' even though create reports persisted:true; recall_count:0; still not-found after an 8s wait (not projection lag). This is a write/read inconsistency in create-evidence-case itself (the exact 'success response is not proof' anti-pattern) -- the effectful read-back bullet cannot be satisfied through this skill as-is.

required_proof_map.bullet: cancellation mid-skill kills owned descendants and emits one terminal blocked/cancelled receipt
required_proof_map.evidence: Requires the bounded-process-ownership executor path (run_cancellable_subprocess exists in skill_dag_adapter for the 3 hard-coded providers; not yet wired for the generic governed path).

required_proof_map.bullet: wrong skill hash or modified SKILL.md fails before dispatch
missing or malformed native output cannot settle PASS
required_proof_map.evidence: map_native_to_tau_receipt native_schema_mismatch; governed_skill_execution verdict derived from evidence (test_verdict_is_derived_from_dod_not_native_status)

required_proof_map.bullet: unsupported skill remains discoverable but reports UNSUPPORTED_ADAPTER
installed-wheel proof with TAU_AGENT_SKILLS_ROOT pointing at a separate checkout

new_code: src/tau_coding/governed_skill_execution.py (governed normalizer: live native output -> admittable envelope, verdict derived from evidence)
tests/test_governed_skill_execution.py (5 passed: admit, verdict-from-evidence, negative, sha-binding, typed error)
proves: The governed execution mechanism works end-to-end for a LIVE bounded mutation: a real code-runner run through scillm produced a diff in an isolated worktree with the source repo untouched, Tau normalized it (deriving the verdict from the deterministic definition-of-done and the write allowlist rather than the skill's own status), admitted the valid diff (PASS), and rejected an out-of-allowlist target (BLOCKED). A real external effect (create-evidence-case) was executed live with a stable, idempotent effect identity (duplicate suppression across re-runs).
does_not_prove: The read-only class admitted end-to-end (review-code emits free text; needs a prose->findings normalizer).
The effectful read-back (create-evidence-case's own `get` cannot retrieve the case it reports as persisted -- a verified defect in that skill).
Cancellation mid-skill and the installed-wheel handshake (not yet run).
verified_blockers_for_closure: create-evidence-case read-back: persisted:true but get returns not-found (recall_count 0, not lag) -- effectful read-back cannot be proven via this skill.
review-code output is unstructured free text -- read-only admission needs a lossy normalizer or a skill that emits structured findings.
